map.基于差减法计算氮、磷、钾养分的表观利用率，评估施肥效果与损失情况: Use the difference method to compute apparent recovery of N, P, K nutrients and assess fertilization effect and losses
map.📖 查看「化肥利用率（氮磷钾吸收率）估算使用指南」: 📖 View the "Fertilizer Use Efficiency (NPK Uptake) Estimator Guide"
map.肥料吸收量 = 作物吸收量 − 土壤基础供肥量；表观利用率 = 肥料吸收量 ÷: Fertilizer uptake = crop uptake - soil baseline supply; apparent recovery = fertilizer uptake / applied x 100%; unrecovered = applied - fertilizer uptake
map.差减法测算当季表观利用率：先扣除土壤基础供肥，得到由肥料贡献的吸收量，再除以施肥: The difference method measures the current-season apparent recovery: first subtract soil baseline supply to get fertilizer-contributed uptake, then divide by applied amount for recovery. The unrecovered part is residue plus loss. Recovery >=40% high, 25%~40% normal, 15%~25% low, <15% too low, each with optimization advice.
map.💡 差减法公式：表观利用率(%) = (作物吸收量 − 土壤基础供肥量) ÷ 施: 💡 Difference-method formula: apparent recovery (%) = (crop uptake - soil baseline supply) / applied x 100; enter N, P2O5, K2O data separately to compute each nutrient recovery
map.差减法需设置不施肥对照区测定土壤基础供肥量，结果为表观利用率: The difference method needs an unfertilized control plot to measure soil baseline supply; the result is apparent recovery
map.一般作物氮肥利用率 30%–45%，磷肥 15%–25%，钾肥 40%–60%，: Typical crop N recovery 30%~45%, P 15%~25%, K 40%~60%; too low means large losses
map.施肥量应换算为纯养分量（如 100kg 尿素含 N 约 46kg）: Applied amount should be pure nutrient (e.g., 100 kg urea contains about 46 kg N)
map.本工具纯前端运行，数据不上传，结果仅供施肥效果评估参考: Pure front-end, no upload; results are for fertilization-effect evaluation only
map.📚 深度解析：化肥利用率（氮磷钾吸收率）估算: 📚 Deep Dive: Fertilizer Use Efficiency (NPK Uptake) Estimator
map.肥料利用率 = (施肥区养分吸收量 − 不施肥区养分吸收量) / 施肥量 × 1: Fertilizer recovery = (fertilized-plot uptake - unfertilized-plot uptake) / applied x 100%.
map.氮肥当季利用率常 30%~45%，磷钾更低。: Current-season N recovery is often 30%~45%, P and K lower.
map.用于评判施肥合理性与减肥潜力。: Used to judge fertilization rationality and reduction potential.
map.施氮区吸氮 12 kg/亩，空白区吸氮 6 kg/亩，施纯 N 15 kg/亩。: N-fertilized plot uptake 12 kg/mu, control 6 kg/mu, applied pure N 15 kg/mu. N recovery = (12-6)/15 = 40%. At the normal level, with deep and split application there is room to reach 45%+.
map.为什么氮肥利用率这么低？: Why is nitrogen recovery so low?
map.氨挥发、硝化反硝化淋失、地表径流等损失大。深施覆土、分次追施、配缓释肥可显著减少: Large losses from ammonia volatilization, nitrification-denitrification leaching, and surface runoff. Deep placement, split topdressing, and slow-release fertilizer significantly cut losses - the core lever of "zero growth in fertilizer use".
map.磷钾肥利用率为什么更难算？: Why are P and K recovery harder to compute?
map.磷在土壤固定、钾有矿物钾缓慢释放，当季吸收与施肥的对应关系弱，常用示踪法（¹⁵N: Phosphorus fixes in soil and potassium releases slowly from mineral K, so current-season uptake poorly tracks application; only tracers (15N/32P) are accurate, while the ordinary difference method overstates error.
